name: auto-handoff
description: Hands a Claude Code session off to a fresh one before the context fills: a Haiku-written brief, /clear, and a seed that points the new session at the brief.

threshold.title: Handoff threshold (tokens)
threshold.description: Context size that triggers a handoff. AUTO_HANDOFF_TOKENS overrides it for a test run. A seeded session hands off no sooner than 40k past its starting size; the panel above the prompt says so when this is set lower.

maxConsecutiveHandoffs.title: Handoffs in a row without a message
maxConsecutiveHandoffs.description: Handoffs allowed before you type a prompt. Past this the mod pauses until you send one.

briefTemplate.title: Brief template file
briefTemplate.description: Markdown file that tells Haiku which sections to write. Created with the defaults on first run; edit it to change the brief.

instructionsTemplate.title: Instructions template file
instructionsTemplate.description: Markdown file that tells the fresh session how to read the brief. Created with the defaults on first run.

ignoreFiles.title: Ignored files (regex)
ignoreFiles.description: Edited files matching this pattern are left out of the brief, such as auto-synced state or caches. Leave blank for none.

viewer.title: Viewer address
viewer.description: Where the mod serves a readable page for each brief, as host:port. "tailscale" as the host means this machine's Tailscale IP, so only your tailnet can open it; without Tailscale it serves on 127.0.0.1. Leave blank for no server; the link is then the local file.

idleMinutes.title: Idle handoff after (minutes)
idleMinutes.description: A message you send after this long idle hands off to a fresh session first and carries your message over, when the session is at least the size below. The prompt cache lasts an hour, so resuming a big session later re-reads all of it at full price. 0 turns this off.

idleMinTokens.title: Idle handoff from (tokens)
idleMinTokens.description: Smallest context the idle handoff applies to. Below it, resuming is cheap enough. 0 means any size.

softCeiling.title: Soft ceiling (tokens)
softCeiling.description: Past this, when no handoff has fired, the model is told once to say so and offer a handover. 0 turns this off.

hardCeiling.title: Hard ceiling (tokens)
hardCeiling.description: Past this, a turn you did not start (a handoff seed, a notification, a queued message) can only run Read, Write, Edit, Glob, Grep and Skill, enough to write a handover. A message you send lifts it for that turn. 0 turns this off.
